scope: Stored finite binary64 dot-product enclosures and strict safe-screening CPU fixtures under declared IEEE arithmetic assumptions; no GPU/model/e2e gain

implementation.procedure: Read actual validation arithmetic and knowledge proof
implementation.acceptance: Declared RN binary64/gradual-underflow assumptions; no input/GPU equivalence conflation; overflow/unknown premise fail closed

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent exact Fraction oracle and adversarial inputs
reference_boundary.acceptance: All accepted enclosures contain exact stored-input dot; cancellation/subnormal/ties/empty/mismatch/nonfinite/overflow plus ranking and physics mapping checked

data_integrity.procedure: Bind code, inputs, config, raw, outputs and environment
data_integrity.acceptance: All current hashes and counts trace to logs; failed evidence retained

numerical_sanity.acceptance: No tolerance-based enclosure pass; endpoint strictness preserves ties; source estimation cannot certify bound

measurement_validity.procedure: No model or speedup claim; elapsed/token diagnostics only
measurement_validity.acceptance: Explicit no model/GPU/Lean and tokenizer unknown; published cases no longer unseen

reproducibility.procedure: Rerun frozen validation and knowledge checks
reproducibility.acceptance: Independent reference cases and reruns reproduce; relevant knowledge/index/contract checks pass

execution.environment_description: local standard-library CPU binary64, Fraction exact oracle
